# Victor Daniel Lopez Pulido
District 2 · Union City Council · 2026
Union City has been my home my entire life. I'm running to fight for the working families who built this city and deserve a seat at the table.
Me postulo para luchar por las familias trabajadoras que merecen un lugar en la mesa.

## Forward
Together
As the child of undocumented parents, I witnessed firsthand the struggles immigrant families face every day. I grew up in Union City, went to these schools, shopped at these stores, and watched working families get pushed out by rising rents and rising prices.
I pursued my education so I could come back and serve this community more effectively — not just as a neighbor, but as an advocate with a seat at the table.
"Quien No Vive Para Servir, No Sirve Para Vivir."
He who does not live to serve, does not deserve to live.

## A Product
of This
City.
Un producto de esta ciudad.
My name is Victor Daniel Lopez Pulido, and Union City has been my home my entire life. My story is one that many families in District 2 can relate to — a story of immigrant parents working hard to give their children opportunities they never had.
As the child of undocumented parents who migrated from Mexico, I witnessed firsthand the struggles and sacrifices that immigrant families make every day. My parents worked tirelessly to provide for our family, often facing barriers and challenges without a voice in the systems that affected their lives. These experiences shaped who I am and instilled in me a deep commitment to service.
I became a first-generation college graduate, earning my B.A. from the University of Arizona and my M.S. from USC. Now, I'm completing my Law degree at USF School of Law. I didn't pursue this education to leave Union City behind — I pursued it so I could come back and serve my community more effectively.
Throughout my journey, I've stayed connected to Union City through service: Chair of the Human Relations Commission, Board Member of Centro de Servicios, active member of the Alameda County Democratic Party, and Faith Formation Instructor at Corpus Christi / Our Lady of the Rosary Parish. Union City gave me everything — now it's time to give back.

## The
Issues
EN ES
01
Housing & Rent Control
Vivienda y Control de Alquileres
Rent control protections against displacement, affordable housing construction, strengthened tenant rights, and developer incentives for affordable unit inclusion.
Protecciones de control de alquiler contra el desplazamiento, construcción de vivienda asequible, fortalecimiento de los derechos de los inquilinos e incentivos para desarrolladores que incluyan unidades accesibles.
→
02
Cost of Living & Food Access
Costo de Vida y Acceso a Alimentos
Support local farmers' markets, food cooperatives, and affordable grocery partnerships. Address food deserts in underserved areas of District 2.
Apoyo a mercados de agricultores locales, cooperativas de alimentos y asociaciones de tiendas asequibles. Atender los desiertos alimentarios en áreas desatendidas del Distrito 2.
→
03
Budget Accountability
Responsabilidad Presupuestaria
Transparent budget processes, elimination of inefficient spending, regular taxpayer audits, and direct investment in working family programs.
Procesos presupuestarios transparentes, eliminación del gasto ineficiente, auditorías regulares de contribuyentes e inversión directa en programas para familias trabajadoras.
→
04
Public Health & Safety
Salud Pública y Seguridad
Expand mental health and addiction services, invest in community-based safety, improve emergency response times, and fund youth violence prevention.
Ampliar los servicios de salud mental y adicciones, invertir en seguridad comunitaria, mejorar los tiempos de respuesta de emergencia y financiar la prevención de la violencia juvenil.
→
05
Education & Youth
Educación y Juventud
Advocate for fully-funded public schools, after-school programs, safe routes to school, and expanded scholarship access for District 2 students.
Abogar por escuelas públicas con financiamiento completo, programas extracurriculares, rutas seguras a la escuela y mayor acceso a becas para estudiantes del Distrito 2.
→
06
Transportation & Infrastructure
Transporte e Infraestructura
Improve road conditions, expand public transit for working families, invest in pedestrian and bicycle safety, and support BART-area development.
Mejorar las condiciones de las vías, ampliar el transporte público para familias trabajadoras, invertir en la seguridad peatonal y ciclista, y apoyar el desarrollo en las zonas de BART.
→
07
Community Engagement
Participación Comunitaria
Regular town halls, language accessibility at city meetings, pathways for immigrant civic participation, and an open-door policy for all constituents.
Reuniones comunitarias regulares, accesibilidad lingüística en las reuniones municipales, vías para la participación cívica de inmigrantes y una política de puertas abiertas para todos los electores.
→
08
Immigrant Rights & Dignity
Derechos y Dignidad del Inmigrante
Protect families from discrimination, ensure undocumented residents can access city services, partner with Centro de Servicios, and advocate for every resident regardless of status.
Proteger a las familias de la discriminación, garantizar que los residentes indocumentados puedan acceder a los servicios municipales, trabajar en alianza con Centro de Servicios y abogar por cada residente independientemente de su estatus migratorio.
→
